text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 04 · 山间旅馆的午后大厅.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: original small Alpine grand hotel lobby circa 1930, viewed level on central axis. Cream limestone columns, softly faded blush plaster, warm walnut reception desk to right side, paired modest staircases rising at far back to a bright mezzanine, wide skylight above providing soft milky daylight. Oatmeal carpet with a muted dusty rose border, understated antique brass fixtures, pale marble counter with one small brass bell and a closed guest book. At left a luggage trolley carries two modest tan cases, hints of a journey but absolutely no staff or guests. Establish balanced layered depth, original room geometry with open central floor, intimate not gigantic. Research inspiration: Grand Budapest Hotel's geometric organization and tactile period design, reinterpreted in quieter cream, warm brown, pale dusty pink, no saturated reds or purple. Emotion: arrival at a hotel full of secrets.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第1批 · 04 · 山间旅馆的午后大厅. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
